title: research-idea-partner cited-references payload v1
description: Machine-readable companion to literature_report.md. Lists only papers the generated ideas actually cite so ScholarSeed can render them in the conversation.

schema_version.description: schema_version Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

project.description: research_ideas/<project> slug Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601; stamped by the client/host, not required from the skill Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

ref_id.description: ALWAYS-PRESENT stable local handle the client links on (paper<->idea), unique within the doc, e.g. 'R1' / 'rafailov2023dpo'. Independent of external ids — a web-only paper with no DOI/arXiv still has a ref_id. Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

paper_id.description: PRIMARY external identifier = PaperHub cross-source doc_id, e.g. 'unified_258959321' (covers non-arXiv too). Empty string when the paper is NOT in PaperHub (e.g. reached only via web search). Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

id_source.description: which identifier this row is keyed on, chosen by PRIORITY for non-PaperHub/web-only sources: paperhub(paper_id) > doi > arxiv > url > title_key(a normalized-title fallback key so the row is still de-dupable) > none. Whatever is chosen, ref_id remains the client's link handle. Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

title_key.description: last-resort stable key for web-only papers with no doi/arxiv/paperhub id: lowercased, punctuation-stripped title (+year if known). Lets the client de-dupe/add-to-library even without a formal id. Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

doi.description: e.g. 10.1145/3600006 — cross-publisher standard, but not all papers have one Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

arxiv_id.description: e.g. 2305.18290 — preprints only Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

url.description: url Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

authors.description: may be empty if not retrieved Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

year.description: year Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

venue.description: venue Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

cited_by.description: which generated idea(s) cite this paper — idea ids/titles from ideas.md, so the panel can link paper <-> idea Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

claim.description: the specific load-bearing claim/number the idea attaches to this paper (for the citation-faithfulness check) Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

verification.description: honesty firewall vocabulary. verified = re-read via agentic-search; unverified = mentioned but not independently checked; unverifiable-in-scope = agentic-search could not reach it (non-arXiv/self-hosted/ResearchGate/patent) — never load-bearing Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL provenance snippet / source locator (e.g. sentence ids or a short quote) supporting the cited claim; null when unverified Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.

has_fulltext.description: whether full text (not just abstract) was available Optional display metadata; missing or invalid values use display defaults.
